Attribute.description:
One attribute in the global pool, identified by `key`.

Rules live only here. A type or a structure node decides that the attribute
applies; it does not add a second definition. When the same key arrives from
several places the object still has the attribute once. A different type or
unit for that key is rejected when the attribute is added.

required.description: The value must be present when the attribute applies. Absent means optional.

AttributeId.description: Id of an attribute in the global pool.

oneOf.description:
Plain text. Length is counted in Unicode scalar values, not bytes.
`form` is `short` or `long`. Language dependence is the attribute flag.
Exact decimal or integer. `min` and `max` are in the base unit when the attribute has one.

integer.description: When true the entered value must be a whole number. Storage stays decimal.

oneOf.description: A closed interval. The value is `{min, max, unit?}`.
Options are inline, or `list` names a [`SharedValueList`] key.
Reference to another object. `type_key` limits the picker; rules check the id shape.
File or media reference. The bytes live outside the object.

fields.description: Attribute keys. The server maps them to the parts that store them.

groups.description: Defaults to loading groups. They are small and decide which values apply.

languages.description: Limits localized `fields` to these language tags.

values.description: Defaults to false. `fields` or `parts` load those value documents anyway.

Cardinality.description: How many links one object may have on this side of a link type.

via.description: `agent` when the actor wrote for a person, `import` for an integration.

Class.description:
Legacy applicability stored on older models.

A class lists attributes for one group. Those attributes apply to that group
and, through the group tree, to every group below it. The editor writes
[`Group::attributes`] instead. Values are never copied from a parent.

oneOf.description: Attribute inheritance. Values are never copied from the parent class.

ClassId.description: Id of a class. A class belongs to exactly one group.

ConflictBody.description: One overlapping edit, named with keys where the model still has them.

DefinitionSet.description:
A definition set is the import and export file for the model.

Authored through the API from phase 3 on, and stored as JSON or YAML in git.
`model_revision` increases by one for every change to the set.

value_lists.description:
Value lists that several attributes can share. An attribute may still
carry its options inline when it does not reference one of these.

ErrorCode.description:
Machine-readable validation failure.

Messages are for people. Callers branch on `code`, together with the
attribute, language and list index that locate the value.

attributes.description: Attributes defined on this node. Ancestor nodes apply as well.

labels.description: Display name per language. Empty on revisions written before labels existed.

parent.description: Parent group key. Absent means a root group.

GroupId.description: Id of a group inside one structure.

parent.description: Parent group key. `null` makes the group a root.

IndexFlags.description: Which parts of the attribute are copied into the search index.

key.description: The key to store. The id does not change.

LanguageTag.description: BCP 47 language tag with an optional region, for example sv or en-GB

LinkLabel.description: The name shown on one side of a link, and the key used later in an attribute path.

LinkSpec.description: Ends of a link type. `from_label` is what the target shows. `to_label` is what the source shows.

ObjectType.description:
An object type. There are no built-in types such as article or product.

`key_attribute` is the value copied into `objects.key`. On a type that has
been given standard attributes it is the `number` attribute. Older sets
still name their own key attribute. `structures` lists the trees the type
may use. `None` means the set was stored before that limit existed.

defaults.description:
Values applied when an object is created without that attribute.

Keys are attribute keys, for example `status` = `draft`.

kind.description: Missing means a normal type. Stored sets from before link types stay entities.

plural.description: Plural display name per language. Empty falls back to an English-style plural of the singular.

singular.description: Singular display name per language. Empty falls back to labels.

structures.description:
Trees this type may be placed in.

Missing means any tree is still allowed. An empty list means the type
has no tree: new objects stay unplaced.

count.description: Live objects in the group and its descendants, or in the whole structure.
Objects that block a structure or group delete.

SharedValueList.description: A value list defined once and referenced by attributes.

Structure.description:
A hierarchy of groups. Nodes are not tied to an object type.

`classes` remains so older revisions still load. New applicability is
`Group::attributes`; the compiler also honours class lists already stored.

key.description: Stable wire key. Object placement uses `key:group`, for example `food:cheese`.

labels.description: Display name per language. Empty on revisions written before labels existed.

StructureError.description: A structure edit that did not change the model.

StructureErrorCode.description: Why a structure edit was refused. `code` is the value clients branch on.

Suggestion.description: A write that was filed for a person to accept. Nothing was saved.

TextForm.description: Short text is one line. Long text is a multi-line value. Both are plain text.

TypeKind.description: An object type is either a normal record or a link between two records.

factor.description: Multiplier into the base unit. Serialized as a decimal string.

UnitFamily.description:
Units that convert to one base unit by multiplication.

`factor` turns an entered value into the base unit: 5000 g with factor
0.001 is 5 kg. The base unit itself has factor 1. Filters and sorting use
the base-unit value; the entered value and unit are what gets stored.

dimension.description:
Shared dimension such as `length` or `mass`. Families with the same
dimension convert through their base unit. Empty means the key is the dimension.

UnitFamilyId.description: Id of a family of units that share a base unit.

ValidationError.description: One validation failure, located as precisely as the value allows.

ValueListId.description: Id of a shared value list.

bearer.description: Dev token from BRAIAN_DEV_TOKENS. An agent token acts for a person.
